newsitem.title: USA: Boston Chicken says $75 million raised by fund.
newsitem.headline: Boston Chicken says $75 million raised by fund.

text.p: Boston Chicken Inc. said Wednesday that Market Partners Llc, an investment fund, completed a $75 million private placement to raise funds to expand the restaurant chain's franchises.
The proceeds will be used to build new stores, said Karen Rugen, spokeswoman for Boston Chicken, owner of Boston Market.
The company currently has 985 Boston Market stores in the United States.
Last month, the Golden, Colo.-based firm's franchisees increased their commitment to build new stores, saying they will open another 2,700 in the next five to seven years.
Market Partners is a private investment fund that includes individuals and institution investors.
The fund raised 50 percent more than originally planned due to strong investor demand, Boston Chicken said.
